title: Let the Right One In (bc30)
synopsis: Set in the Stockholm suburb of Blackeberg in 1981, Oskar, a bullied 12-year-old, strikes up a friendship with his new neighbour, the mysterious and moody Eli. She is full of contradictions; her wise look, her strange smell, the fact that she is wearing such thin clothing, her neglected and skinny, yet so beautiful, appearance. Initially reserved, a sweet romance blossoms between them. But a dark, macabre secret revealing Eli's connection to a string of bloody local murders threatens everything. Along with Black Ice, it sparked a new wave of interest in Nordic crime movies at the time, including films such as The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo and Headhunters.

synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 瑞典小鎮鄉郊，12 歲的奧斯卡經常被同學欺凌卻從不敢反擊，直至同樣是 12歲的新鄰居艾莉出現，命運從此改寫。不知是巧合還是一股神秘力量，艾莉來到這小鎮後，血腥事件接連出現，但對於內向的奧斯卡來說，這一連串的陰森故事卻吸引著吸引著他，無論跟艾莉一起有多危險，也不願離開她。 在白雪紛飛，染上腥紅的寒冬，兩個同樣孤獨，身處社會邊緣的靈魂彼此依靠，發展出一段純真、唯美卻又伴隨著血腥與殘酷的獨特關係。當年掀起了新一股北歐犯罪電影熱潮，包括《誰和誰和誰有路》及後來的《龍紋身的女孩》和《獵頭遊戲》。
